title: Zebra holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#e8e8f0'/>

  <path d='M30 53 Q34 62 28 71' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M38 51 Q42 62 36 73' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 62 44 74' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M54 51 Q58 62 52 73' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='6' height='4' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='78' width='6' height='4' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='27' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3a3a66'/>
  <rect x='53' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3a3a66'/>

  <path d='M67 42 Q71 36 69 31' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='70' cy='26' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='29' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c9c9dd'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='28' r='1.4' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- Head stripes -->
  <path d='M64 20 Q68 26 63 32' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M70 18 Q73 24 69 30' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <path d='M64 18 L61 10 L68 16 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <path d='M72 17 L73 9 L77 16 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='2' fill='#2c2c55'/>
  <circle cx='72.7' cy='23.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M62 18 Q58 22 60 28 Q56 30 58 36' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart held near front -->
  <path d='M30 30 C24 22 14 26 16 34 C18 40 30 46 30 46 C30 46 42 40 44 34 C46 26 36 22 30 30 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M24 29 C22 26 18 27 18 31' stroke='#ff9eb0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Front leg holding heart -->
  <rect x='34' y='44' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-15 36 50)'/>
</svg>
